name: White Horse Lounge
description: White Horse is a friendly neighborhood karaoke bar that offers a lively and welcoming atmosphere. It features karaoke three nights a week, with a fun crowd that enjoys singing and socializing. The staff is friendly and attentive, creating a relaxed environment. The venue serves food and drinks, including inexpensive options, and opens early at 7am, making it accessible for various schedules. Its reputation for good service, fun nights, and a community vibe makes it a standout spot for karaoke enthusiasts seeking a casual, enjoyable experience.
